INTERNAL_CHAT.TITLE: Team chat
INTERNAL_CHAT.NO_CHANNELS: No conversations yet. Start one with a colleague.
INTERNAL_CHAT.ASK_HELP_TOOLTIP: Send this message as a help request to {name} only

ERRORS.LOAD: Could not load the team chat. Try again.
ERRORS.SEND: Could not send the message. Try again.
ERRORS.OPEN: Could not open this conversation. Try again.
ERRORS.NUDGE: Wait a bit before calling their attention again.
ERRORS.CLAIM: Could not take this help request. Maybe someone already did.

URGENT.LABEL: Urgent
URGENT.TOOLTIP: Mark as urgent: the person is notified even outside business hours

NUDGE.TOOLTIP: Call their attention (can't be used again right away)

MENTION.NOTIFIES: Mentioning notifies the person even outside business hours

HELP.STATUS_OPEN: Waiting for someone to take it
HELP.TAKEN_JOINED: You joined the customer conversation as a participant
HELP.TAKEN_NOT_JOINED: You have no access to the inbox of that customer conversation

AUDIT.TITLE: Audit
AUDIT.NOTE: Audit mode: every conversation you open here is recorded.

DATA_RETENTION.TITLE: Data retention
DATA_RETENTION.NOTE: How long internal chat messages and resolved customer conversations are kept. Nothing is deleted unless the automatic cleanup is turned on.
DATA_RETENTION.CLEANUP_LABEL: Delete automatically what is past these periods
DATA_RETENTION.CLEANUP_NOTE: Deleting can't be undone. Check what would be removed first with the retention:report task.
DATA_RETENTION.FAILED: Could not update the retention settings
DATA_RETENTION.ERROR: Use a whole number of days between 1 and 3650

POSTING.ADMINS_ONLY_NOTE: Only administrators can send messages in this room.
POSTING.ADMINS_AND_SUPERVISORS_NOTE: Only administrators and supervisors can send messages in this room.

ROOMS.TITLE: Chat rooms
ROOMS.NOTE: Choose who can send messages in each room. Everyone in the room can always read. Company announcements work well with a restricted room.
